lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a grouping or uniqueness key uses database case folding lower upper test a non ascii case pair sao sao and state the required utf 8 lc ctype in the spec because folding depends on the database locale
lessons.text: When a grouping or uniqueness key uses database case folding (lower/upper), test a non-ASCII case pair (SÃO/São) and state the required UTF-8 LC_CTYPE in the spec, because folding depends on the database locale.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the spec keeps variants distinct but orders them with a comparison that ignores the difference accent insensitive collator name the tie break in the spec so tests do not enforce an unstated choice
lessons.text: When the spec keeps variants distinct but orders them with a comparison that ignores the difference (accent-insensitive collator), name the tie-break in the spec so tests do not enforce an unstated choice.

lessons.key: ac_gap::set the pgjdbc property logservererrordetail false when logs must be pii free unique violation detail echoes the key value into hibernate s warn log
lessons.text: Set the PgJDBC property logServerErrorDetail=false when logs must be PII-free; unique-violation detail echoes the key value into Hibernate's WARN log.

lessons.key: ac_gap::tick application clocks in microseconds when timestamps are stored in postgresql timestamptz or returned values differ from stored ones on linux jdks with nanosecond clocks
lessons.text: Tick application clocks in microseconds when timestamps are stored in PostgreSQL timestamptz, or returned values differ from stored ones on Linux JDKs with nanosecond clocks.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a test for nothing except x is exposed must assert the whole exposed set e g the discovery listing not probe a few sample names
lessons.text: A test for 'nothing except X is exposed' must assert the whole exposed set (e.g. the discovery listing), not probe a few sample names.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::give every check digit branch e g remainder 10 0 its own unit case a data generator that hits it by chance is not evidence
lessons.text: Give every check-digit branch (e.g. remainder 10 -> 0) its own unit case; a data generator that hits it by chance is not evidence.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec promises a per field errors array state whether query parameters and unparseable values are included
lessons.text: When a spec promises a per-field errors array, state whether query parameters and unparseable values are included.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the author narrows an ac to match current behaviour after verification log it as an unconfirmed assumption for the user never as settled spec
lessons.text: When the author narrows an AC to match current behaviour after verification, log it as an unconfirmed assumption for the user, never as settled spec.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::never put test only settings in a production config location config application properties it shadows production config in every test use a test bean or profile and run mvn clean after deleting resources
lessons.text: Never put test-only settings in a production config location (config/application.properties); it shadows production config in every test. Use a test bean or profile, and run mvn clean after deleting resources.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert every contract field of error responses type title detail instance not only status and content type mutants that drop a field survive status only checks
lessons.text: Assert every contract field of error responses (type, title, detail, instance), not only status and content type; mutants that drop a field survive status-only checks.

lessons.key: gate_fail::put archunit violation fixtures outside the application s base package spring component and entity scanning picks up fixture entity component classes and breaks every integration test
lessons.text: Put ArchUnit violation fixtures outside the application's base package; Spring component and entity scanning picks up fixture @Entity/@Component classes and breaks every integration test.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a refactor moves exception translation from a global handler to each call site add a test for every call site a behaviour that was structurally global becomes per path and can regress silently
lessons.text: When a refactor moves exception translation from a global handler to each call site, add a test for every call site; a behaviour that was structurally global becomes per-path and can regress silently.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when two defenses guard one requirement explicit version check and transactional versioned update mutate each alone and both together and state in the design which defense is live in production
lessons.text: When two defenses guard one requirement (explicit version check and transactional versioned UPDATE), mutate each alone and both together, and state in the design which defense is live in production.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::requirements like implemented once or delegates to x need a structural rule archunit call or dependency assertion behavioural tests cannot tell a copy from delegation
lessons.text: Requirements like 'implemented once' or 'delegates to X' need a structural rule (ArchUnit call or dependency assertion); behavioural tests cannot tell a copy from delegation.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::an archunit rule that only checks an annotation s presence or a call s existence can be evaded propagation supports ignored result constrain the attribute or only calls x or pin it with a behaviour test
lessons.text: An ArchUnit rule that only checks an annotation's presence or a call's existence can be evaded (propagation=SUPPORTS, ignored result); constrain the attribute or 'only calls X', or pin it with a behaviour test.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a race test disables a pre check by stubbing a spy assert the downstream effect the write was attempted after clearing arrangement invocations verifying the stubbed call is not enough because the real pre check may still answer
lessons.text: When a race test disables a pre-check by stubbing a spy, assert the downstream effect (the write was attempted, after clearing arrangement invocations); verifying the stubbed call is not enough because the real pre-check may still answer.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::re verification must attack the new guards themselves with evasion mutants not only replay old survivors replaying alone gives a false pass
lessons.text: Re-verification must attack the new guards themselves with evasion mutants, not only replay old survivors; replaying alone gives a false PASS.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a class level annotation rule does not bound effective behaviour when spring resolves method level annotations first guard effective attributes transaction security cache with a behavioural probe instead of one static rule per annotation level
lessons.text: A class-level annotation rule does not bound effective behaviour when Spring resolves method-level annotations first; guard effective attributes (transaction, security, cache) with a behavioural probe instead of one static rule per annotation level.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::use onlycallcodeunitsthat rather than onlycallmethodsthat when a class must compute nothing itself method only rules leave constructor calls open
lessons.text: Use onlyCallCodeUnitsThat rather than onlyCallMethodsThat when a class must compute nothing itself; method-only rules leave constructor calls open.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::put multi step test arrangements that guard against vacuity stub clearinvocations in one helper separate lines can each be forgotten
lessons.text: Put multi-step test arrangements that guard against vacuity (stub + clearInvocations) in one helper; separate lines can each be forgotten.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a runs in a transaction probe must prove the read and the write share the same transaction a check at one call site misses requires new splits including on outbound adapters count completed transactions per request instead
lessons.text: A 'runs in a transaction' probe must prove the read and the write share the same transaction; a check at one call site misses REQUIRES_NEW splits, including on outbound adapters. Count completed transactions per request instead.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::pair every mutation that is invisible over http with the mutation that removes the other guard and run that guard s removal alone as a control to expose the real consequence e g a lost update
lessons.text: Pair every mutation that is invisible over HTTP with the mutation that removes the other guard, and run that guard's removal alone as a control, to expose the real consequence (e.g. a lost update).
